_what: The personal-data firewall's patterns (tools/check_personal_data.py). The scanner holds no patterns of its own: a new category is a new entry here, with its reason and synthetic fixtures, and no code change. Every fixture below is SYNTHETIC - a fake 1990 date, a neutral city, a made-up pillar chart, an impossible SSN - so the gate proves it detects the real shapes without storing the real values. Real values are checked separately, as keyed hashes kept under state/, never here.
_principal: Set 2026-11-03: fail closed; patterns live here; every catch is logged and becomes a test case the gate keeps.

github_fine_grained_token.why: a GitHub fine-grained personal access token
github_fine_grained_token.seed: leak 1, 2026-11-03: a github_pat_ token sat in plain text in config/mcp.d/git.json (gitignored, never committed). check_no_secrets matches gh[pousr]_ only and would not have caught this shape.
fixtures_miss: GITHUB_TOKEN is read from .env and never written here

birth_time_with_longitude.why: a clock time with a longitude - the shape of a birth moment and place
birth_time_with_longitude.seed: leak 2, 2026-11-03: a docstring example in ati/bazi.py carried the principal's birth time and longitude; caught before publishing.
fixtures_miss: the year turns at 315 degrees of solar longitude

birth_date_keyed.why: a date tied to a birth
fixtures_miss: birth data is read from the natal record at runtime
born out of necessity in 2024 the gate

precise_coordinates.why: a coordinate precise enough to locate a place (3+ decimals)

bazi_chart.pattern: [甲乙丙丁戊己庚辛壬癸][子丑寅卯辰巳午未申酉戌亥](?:[\s,'"·/|\-]{0,4}[甲乙丙丁戊己庚辛壬癸][子丑寅卯辰巳午未申酉戌亥]){3}
bazi_chart.why: a full four-pillar chart - it encodes a birth date and hour
fixtures_hit: 庚午 壬午 丙寅 乙未
fixtures_miss: the 甲戌 year pillar alone

ssn_shape.why: something shaped like a Social Security number

va_dod_identity.why: a VA file / claim number or a DoD ID (EDIPI)

name_with_place.why: a person's name tied to a place
fixtures_hit: Jordan Example was born in Springfield, Illinois
fixtures_miss: the principal lives with two plants in one tent

allowlist.why: the scanner and its synthetic self-tests

allowlist.contains: pillars("2024-02-10T12:00", "Asia/Shanghai", lon=121.47)   # -> 甲辰 丙寅 甲辰 庚午
allowlist.why: neutral docstring example (Lunar New Year 2024, Shanghai) - the replacement for leak 2
synthetic reference dates (2000-01-01, 2024-02-03/10) and a synthetic natal fixture proving the BaZi derivation

the public-domain corpus (statutes, regulations, the IRM, Black's 1910): legal prose about birth and residence, not a person's data. Tokens, coordinates, birth times, pillar charts and the derived layer still apply there.
files check_no_secrets already reviewed for SSN-shaped content, each with its reason - read from there at scan time so the decision lives in one place

derived._: The principal's REAL values are never written here. --refresh-derived reads the live natal record from Hermes and keeps only HMAC-SHA256 digests of its date, time, coordinates and pillar chart, under a random local key - both in state/personal_data/, owner-only. A staged file holding any of those values is caught even if it fits no pattern above. CI has no state/, so this layer runs locally and on the pre-commit hook, and CI reports it as skipped.

learned_cases.seed: leak 1 - token in config/mcp.d/git.json, never committed
leak 2 - birth time and longitude in an ati/bazi.py docstring, caught before publishing
